title: 安洵杯 2020 EasyCM
description: Windows exe with SMC (self-modifying code) self-decoding via a section named '.cyzcc'. Two sub-threads: one encrypts a pseudo-flag to a comparison string; the other builds a base table from a data blob then swaps the table after thread sync. Recover the real flag via IDC script on the SMC-decoded code, or by manually decrypting the '.cyzcc' section. Reconstructed from 安洵杯官方wp (local PDF). Flag from official writeup.
